important_instructions: This recruitment is only for serving ALP/Sr. ALP employees in the regular cadre of Indian Railway - it is not an open/direct recruitment for candidates outside the Railway. Applications must be sent through proper channel via the candidate's Administrative Office (Zonal Railway, Production Unit, Railway Board, etc.), which must mention APAR gradings for the last five years, along with No Objection, Vigilance, and DAR Clearance. Applications not forwarded through proper channel, or incomplete applications, may not be considered. Eligible and suitable applicants will be shortlisted based on eligibility and experience, if required, as per the Vacancy Notice. Konkan Railway holds all rights to alter the number of vacancies and other procedures, or to cancel the recruitment against this notification, as it may deem fit, without citing any reason.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be holding the post of ALP/Sr. ALP in the regular cadre of Indian Railway. Candidates must possess the requisite A1 Medical classification and be medically fit to perform Running Staff duties. Any one of the following: Matriculation/SSLC plus ITI from a recognised institution of NCVT/SCVT in the trades of Armature and Coil Winder / Electrician / Electronics Mechanic / Filter / Heat Engine / Instrument Mechanic / Machinist / Mechanic Diesel / Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) / Millwright Maintenance Mechanic / Mechanic Radio & TV / Refrigeration and Air-Conditioning Mechanic / Tractor Mechanic / Turner / Wireman; OR Matriculation/SSLC plus course-completed Act Apprenticeship in the trades mentioned above; OR HSC/12th Std. (10+2) Science pass in regular schooling; OR 3-year Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile Engineering, or a combination of these engineering disciplines, from a recognised institution, in lieu of ITI; OR A Degree in the engineering disciplines mentioned above, in lieu of a Diploma in Engineering.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not more than 45 years, as on the date of notification (22.09.2026).

faq.question: Q1. What is KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Vacancy Notice No. DE/ALP/01/2026 issued by Konkan Railway Corporation Limited, inviting applications on deputation basis from serving ALP/Sr. ALP employees of Indian Railway, for 66 posts at KRCL's Crew Lobbies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 66 total vacancies for Assistant Loco Pilot and Senior Assistant Loco Pilot posts.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for KRCL ALP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only candidates already holding the post of ALP/Sr. ALP in the regular cadre of Indian Railway, with the requisite A1 Medical classification and fitness for Running Staff duties, are eligible - this is not open to candidates outside the Railway.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application through proper channel must reach KRCL by 22.10.2026 (17:00 hrs), with an advance copy to be emailed by 19.10.2026 (17:00 hrs).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years, as on the date of notification (22.09.2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot posts?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-2 and Level-4; the employee draws pay admissible on the parent Railway, plus deputation (duty) allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the term of appointment for this KRCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The appointment is on deputation basis, with a normal term of 3 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KRCL Assistant Loco Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible, suitable applicants are shortlisted based on eligibility and experience, as per the Vacancy Notice - no written exam is mentioned.
